name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: Pick a single date, a date and a time, or a date range from a calendar popover — token-styled, keyboard-navigable, with optional quick presets.

meta.whenToUse: Selecting a single date, a date with a time of day (DateTimePicker: the calendar and the time in one popup, on the reader's clock), or a range (with optional Today/Last-7-days presets) from a popover. size="sm" + variant="ghost" is the inline row tier; clearable adds a clear control that returns focus to the trigger.
meta.whenNotToUse: Free-form/partial dates (masked Input) or inline-only calendars (use Calendar directly).
